passages.note: Final Senate floor concurrence vote on SB 3; McGuire voted Aye.

passages.provision_quote: Following the implementation of the minimum wage increase specified in subparagraph (F) of paragraph (2) of subdivision (b), on or before August 1 of that year, and on or before each August 1 thereafter, the Director of Finance shall calculate an adjusted minimum wage.
passages.note: Chaptered bill text: after the scheduled step increases to $15, the law requires annual CPI-W-based wage adjustments with no further legislative vote.

rows.reasoning: McGuire voted Aye on final concurrence for SB 3 (2015-2016). The enacted text requires the Director of Finance to annually calculate an adjusted minimum wage using a CPI-W formula after the scheduled step increases are implemented, with each adjustment taking effect automatically and no further legislative vote required, matching the rung 'Raise the wage floor and tie it to the cost of living, so it rises automatically each year without new legislation.'
